d:
Anbukku Naan Adimai Tamil Movie Songs HD, Kaattiloru Singakuttiyam Video Song featuring Rajinikanth, Rati Agnihotri and Sujatha on Mango Music Tamil. Music by Ilayaraja, directed by R. Thyagarajan and produced by C. Dandayuthapani.
Song: Kaattiloru Singakuttiyam
Singer: SPB
Lyrics: Panchu Arunachalam
Anbukku Naan Adimai movie also stars Vijayan, Thengai Srinivasan, Surulirajan and Jayamalini among others.
